READ THESE INSTRUCTIONS FIRST

Answer one question from your chosen Depth Study.
The number of marks is given in brackets [ ] at the end of each question or part question.

Answer one question from your chosen Depth Study.
DEPTH STUDY A: THE FIRST WORLD WAR, 1914–1918
1 How significant was the Gallipoli Campaign in 1915? Explain your answer. [40]
How important was the use of aircraft to the conduct of the war? Explain your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY B: GERMANY, 1918–1945
How significant were Röhm and the SA in the development of the Nazi Party to 1934? Explain
your answer. [40]
How important were women in German society under the Nazis? Explain your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY C: RUSSIA, 1905–1941
How important was Bolshevik agitation in the fall of the Provisional Government in 1917? Explain
your answer. [40]
How significant was collectivisation in modernising the Soviet economy? Explain your answer.
DEPTH STUDY D: THE USA, 1919–1941
How significant was the Ku Klux Klan during the 1920s? Explain your answer. [40]
How important were President Roosevelt’s ‘Hundred Days’ from March to June 1933 in dealing
with the consequences of the Wall Street Crash? Explain your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY E: CHINA, c.1930–c.1990
How important in bringing about social change between 1949 and 1958 were women’s rights
reforms? Explain your answer. [40]
How significant to Mao’s control of China was the Hundred Flowers Campaign, 1956–57? Explain
your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY F: SOUTH AFRICA, c.1940–c.1994
How important was the Freedom Charter of 1955 in the development of opposition to apartheid?
Explain your answer. [40]
How significant was white opposition to the transition to majority rule between 1980 and 1994?
Explain your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY G: ISRAELIS AND PALESTINIANS SINCE 1945
How significant to the peace process in the Middle East have the rivalries between Palestinian
groups been? Explain your answer. [40]
How important a role has oil played in the Arab-Israeli conflict? Explain your answer. [40]
